name: design-flow
description: The experience-design loop: ui-designer authors docs/ui (design brief, WCAG-validated tokens, screen inventory with declared states — RFC-0030) and /design-flow:view runs the live co-design surface whose clicks, notes, and candidate picks land in events.jsonl for the agent's next round. Meets ddd-flow at docs/domain/ and swe-flow at docs/ui/; authors drafts, never flips a status.
